name.es: Unidad de monitoreo de corriente residual (RCMU, interna al inversor)

description.en: All-pole sensitive residual-current monitoring unit inside the inverter that monitors AC and DC residual currents and disconnects the inverter from the grid.
description.es: Unidad sensible de todos los polos interna al inversor que vigila corrientes residuales AC y DC y desconecta el inversor de la red.

sources.title: SMA manual: residual-current monitoring unit (RCMU) and external RCD
SMA manual: Protective devices (DC load-break switch, reverse polarity diode, AC 60 A, Riso)

note.en: Residual-current monitoring in PV inverters (cited in the Kostal note)
note.es: Vigilancia de corriente residual en inversores FV (citada en la nota Kostal)

note.en: SMA: disconnects from the grid when residual-current jumps exceed 30 mA
note.es: SMA: desconecta de la red si el salto de corriente residual supera 30 mA

note.en: SMA STP 50 US: all-pole residual-current monitoring listed as available, not mandatory
note.es: SMA STP 50 US: vigilancia de corriente residual de todos los polos, disponible, no obligatoria

when_to_use.en: Internal to the inverter; it is not an external RCD and does not replace one where local rules require it.
when_to_use.es: Interno al inversor; no es un RCD externo y no reemplaza uno si la norma local lo exige.

when_not_to_use.en: Do not draw as an external RCD on the SLD unless the design includes one (see rcd_type_b).
when_not_to_use.es: No dibujar como RCD externo en el SLD salvo que el diseño lo incluya (ver rcd_type_b).
